'''Alpha Company''' was a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] military unit active on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Raxus Prime/Legends|Raxus Prime]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It was composed of at least three [[All Terrain Tactical Enforcer/Legends|AT-TEs]] and four [[All Terrain Experimental Transport|AT-XTs]].

==History==
During the [[Dark Reaper crisis]], this unit was ferried to Raxus Prime via an [[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship/Legends|''Acclamator''-class assault ship]] to assist [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi Generals]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] in their efforts to prevent [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] from excavating the [[Force Harvester]], a vital instrument needed to power the [[Dark Reaper]].<ref name="CWPOSG" />

Leading the group on a direct assault from the front with their [[TX-130 Saber-class fighter tank/Legends|fighter tanks]], they were attacked by multiple waves of [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|CIS]] forces composed of numerous [[OG-9 homing spider droid/Legends|Homing spider droids]], [[Ground Armored Tank]]s, [[IG-227 Hailfire-class droid tank|Hailfire droids]], [[Heavy Artillery Gun]]s, and [[NR-N99 Persuader-class droid enforcer/Legends|NR-N-99 droid tanks]]. Upon reaching the perimeter of the base of the excavation site, Kenobi maneuvered through the confines of an industrial complex to eliminate remaining separatist forces.<ref name="CWPOSG" />

As Republic forces began to converge on the site, Kenobi moved to engage the fuel bays supporting an excavation crane whilst Skywalker and AT-XTs' focused on nearby enemy forces. With the crane eliminated, Kenobi then destroyed a [[Power generator/Legends|generator]] that powered a force field gate where [[Beta Squadron (Galactic Republic)|republic reinforcements]] lie in wait on the other side. With all confederacy forces eliminated, Dooku presented himself in the open flanked by two [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|battle droids]], in which Skywalker immediately pursued him aboard a [[Hardcell-class interstellar transport/Legends|Hardcell transport]].<ref name="CWPOSG" />

Seconds later, a [[Protodeka]] revealed itself and quickly destroyed the remaining Republic forces in the area, leaving Kenobi alone on the field whilst Skywalker is aboard the already launched transport. After a tense skirmish, the Protodeka was inevitably destroyed. [[Cloning/Legends|Clone]] forces in the area then reported to Kenobi that the Separatists had already found whatever it is they were searching for.<ref name="CWPOSG" />
